text:
Maya: Orbit QBR confirmed for Thu 4pm PT. Need a short health snapshot, onboarding cadence update, top renewal risk, and one clear exec ask. Drop bullet updates here by Tue EOD.

Diego: I'll own the health slide. Will include p95 latency (current 420ms -> target 350ms) and cost per 1k tokens.

Rina: I'll handle onboarding status + blockers. Current pipeline: 8 accounts in onboarding, 5 green, 2 blocked on dataset mapping, 1 awaiting legal.

Jamal: Renewal risk flagged AMBER for two accounts. Reason: demo instability during scheduled exec demos. Raised support ticket #4302 and started a hotfix runbook.

Kai: For the exec ask I propose: "Approve 6-week canary Dedicated pool for top 10 accounts and 40 SE hours for fast fixes." I'll draft impact metrics (expected drop in demo failures and SLA lift).

Maya: Jamal can you post the 1-line risk blurb we can use on the risk slide? Keep it to one sentence + mitigation.

Jamal: "Renewal risk: AMBER 1 high-touch accounts observed demo failures due to connector timeouts; mitigation: canary Dedicated pool + engineering hotfix in progress."

Diego: Heads-up: I'll add a small table showing before/after expected p95 and cost delta for the pilot.

Rina: ETA on unblock for dataset mapping = 10 business days if we get SE support this sprint. Legal ETA = 2 weeks. I'll add owners in the slide.

Kai: I'll include a fallback plan if pilot denied: temporary routing rules + increased retries + customer-facing script for demos.

Maya: Two logistics items: (1) slide deck link -> https://drive.redwood/Orbit-QBR-Deck (please add slide by Wed 9am PT); (2) dry run Wed 11am PT. sched-bot will post invites.

sched-bot: Created event: Orbit QBR dry run 1 Wed 11:00 PT. Invitees: Maya, Diego, Rina, Jamal, Kai.

Diego: Also adding a one-liner customer quote: "Response quality solid, but demo reliability needs work" (anonymized).

Rina: Added onboarding timeline to Drive and tagged SE for dataset mapping.

Jamal: Uploaded support incident summary and proposed hotfix steps.

Kai: Drafted exec ask slide with bullets: objective, ask, expected outcomes, and cost delta.

Maya: Recap: slides in Drive by Wed 9am PT; dry run Wed 11am PT; final deck to exec Thurs 1pm PT. Thanks team.

Diego: Will highlight routes: text.generate and embeddings.search.

Rina: Noted. If legal clears earlier I'll update the timeline.

Maya: Ping me if you need any deck templates or data extracts.
